task_description: Issue #42: add an affection (なつき度) parameter to the AI Monster game. Define value domain + increase/decrease rules in @ddm/shared with unit tests (raised by care actions, chatting, battle wins; lowered by neglect/starving). Integrate into createMonster/feed/train/sleep/clean/applyTimePassage and battle-win. Add a pet/なでる sprite-click action with a per-day cap. Affection influences chat tone (JA+EN Bedrock system prompt). Accessible heart gauge in StatsPanel. Backward compatible: legacy saves with no affection default to the initial value and are not rejected by validateMonster. JA/EN parity, no new runtime deps, respect prefers-reduced-motion. Backend Lambda (chat.ts/battle.ts + bundled @ddm/shared) and frontend both change => both need redeploy.
